hook.text: Every smartphone on Earth runs iOS or Android. There is no meaningful third option.

buildup.text: Two companies — Apple and Google — control the gateway to the mobile internet.

discovery.text: Both take a 30% cut of app sales, set the rules, and can remove any app at will.

twist.text: Regulators worldwide are forcing both platforms to open up — but change is slow.

climax.text: The duopoly shapes what software gets built and who profits from mobile innovation.

punchline.text: Two companies own the mobile future.

quiz.question: What percentage of smartphones run iOS or Android?
